scope: model scope palette and eligible-surface transaction

behavior.palette: copied from the first D3D draw whether or not that draw is an HDR model candidate
behavior.surfaces: eligible surfaces append with strictly increasing sparse ordinals
behavior.completion: next scope or explicit frame boundary publishes one owned transaction

validation.native_groups: owned palette, sparse surfaces, boundaries, rejection
